title: Correct unit conversion
description: Essential: Student correctly converts initial and final speeds from km/h to m/s.

title: Correct final time
description: Essential: Student arrives at the correct numerical answer for the time (50 s).

title: Applies correct kinematic equation
description: Important: Student identifies and correctly applies the equation v = v0 + a*t or its rearrangement.

title: Correct sign for acceleration
description: Important: Student uses the given acceleration as a positive value in the calculation.

title: Includes proper units
description: Optional: Student consistently includes and states the correct units (m/s, m/s², s) in the solution.

title: Incorrect unit conversion
description: Pitfall: Student fails to convert speeds to consistent units (e.g., uses km/h with m/s²).

title: Algebraic or arithmetic error
description: Pitfall: Student makes an error in rearranging the formula or in the final calculation.
